import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(clc_shape_offsets(3,3,3,False), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(clc_shape_offsets(5,4,2,False), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(clc_shape_offsets(6,6,6,True), target)

import numpy as np
# boundary: the smallest crystal, one shell of twenty six cells
assert np.allclose(clc_shape_offsets(1,1,1,False), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(clc_direct_potential(np.array([1.,1,1]),np.array([[0.,0,0],[0.5,0,0]]),np.array([1.,-1]),1,12,12,12,False), target)

import numpy as np

import numpy as np
# boundary: a crystal one cell thick along z, where the shape is a plate

import numpy as np
# boundary: a small splitting parameter, where the real space part carries most of the sum

import numpy as np

import numpy as np

import numpy as np

import numpy as np
# all entries except the aspect scores and J

import numpy as np

# all entries except the aspect scores and J

import numpy as np
# aspect scores and J: ratios of small fit diagnostics, sensitive to summation order
